pay_detail: Tuition $3,400 plus a $100 audition fee credited to tuition. Housing and meal plans cost extra (2027 rates are not set). Need-based aid and merit scholarships exist.
notes: Directed by Prof. Mimi Zweig (zweig@iu.edu). Confirm 2027 housing prices.
name: Summer String Academy (Jacobs School of Music)
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A four-week summer program for serious young string players. It has weekly student concerts, Summer Festival concerts and a final gala. It began in 1984 and welcomes students from around the world.
who_can_apply: Serious string players ages 12 to 18. You must audition by recording.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application and audition are due February 10, 2027, with acceptance notices by February 24 and tuition due March 4, 2027. The page says applications will open soon, with no day given.
how_to_apply: Pay the $100 fee in the online sign-up form. Then upload two different pieces as recordings to the Jacobs audition portal. YouTube links are fine. You also need a letter from your main teacher. Pay tuition only after you are accepted.
